Small talk in voice (chatting, venting, jokes) goes to the companion service and is answered in Bothy\'s own voice; requests to do something still go to Bothy. Jev gives each turn one more score for “is this small talk”, and turns that mention navigation, the AC, playing music and the like, or that come right after Bothy asked a question, always go to Bothy; when the companion service fails or judges that something should be done, the turn goes back to Bothy too.
